name: Robe of the Glowing Arcana
body:
ROBE OF THE GLOWING ARCANA

Aura faint abjuration; CL 1st; Slot body; Price 900 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This dark silk robe is embroidered with luminous silver runes. Upon command, it casts mage armor upon the wearer (+4 armor bonus to AC for 1 hour). However, while active, the glowing runes shed bright light in a 10-foot radius that shines through cloaks and blankets, imposing a -10 penalty on all Stealth checks.

A newly created robe has 15 charges.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells light, mage armor; Cost 450 gp.
